description: The executable Horn decision procedure returns true exactly when the associated shared propositional clause set has a satisfying Boolean valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.accepts_correct.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.accepts Γ = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Sat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.clauseSet Γ)
